Footer.tagline: Cheers from your loved ones, triggered by GPS at the exact points along your route.

Meta.tagline: Your loved ones’ voices, at the right kilometer
Meta.description: Your loved ones leave a voice message on your route. On race day, your phone plays it at the right kilometer • no network, nothing to read.

Landing.metaTitle: EchoRun • your loved ones’ voices, at the right kilometer
Landing.heroBody: Your loved ones leave a voice message on a precise spot of your route. On race day, your phone plays it all by itself as you run past. You just run. They’re right there with you.
Landing.heroNote: Free for your loved ones · {cap} free messages · no app
Landing.modesTitle: With or without a file, there’s always a way

gpx.title: Import your GPX
gpx.body: Your race file • the organizer’s or your Strava export. We pull the route from it down to the meter.

draw.title: Draw your route
draw.body: Drop your points on the map and EchoRun snaps them to real roads. Perfect for a training run or a home loop.

time.title: Go by time
time.body: Set your duration • say 2 h • and your loved ones drop their voices on a timeline. The clock triggers them to the exact minute.

Landing.stepsTitle: Three minutes to set it all up

create.title: You create your race
create.body: Import your GPX, draw your route on the map, or just set a duration. Three ways, two minutes, no complicated account.

share.title: You share a link
share.body: One unique link, like a Tricount. Your loved ones have no account to create and no app to install. They open it, they speak, done.

dayOf.title: Race day does the rest
dayOf.body: During the race, your phone announces “Message from Camille” then plays their voice, right at the right spot • or the right minute. No network needed.

Landing.useCasesTitle: A cheer is only worth its timing

marathon.title: The wall at km 30
marathon.body: In a marathon, everyone knows where it breaks. Place three voices between km 30 and 35: that’s exactly where they help.

trail.title: Where no one can reach
trail.body: Passes, forests, aid stations you can’t get to. Your loved ones can’t stand by the trail • but their voice can.

tenK.title: Your first bib
tenK.body: The finish line is scary when you’ve never crossed it. A message 500 m from the end changes how the story ends.

surprise.title: A birthday in a bib
surprise.body: Running on your 40th birthday and getting ten surprise messages spread along the route. No one sees it coming.

Landing.benefitsTitle: Built for the only moment that counts: during the effort.

noApp.label: Zero app for your loved ones
noApp.body: A web link. It works on your mum’s old iPhone as well as your brother’s Android.

noNetwork.label: Zero network during the race
noNetwork.body: The voice messages are downloaded to your phone the day before. Deep in the forest, it works just the same.

nothingToTouch.label: Nothing to touch while running
nothingToTouch.body: No notification to read, no screen to unlock. It speaks in your earphones, you keep running.

youKeep.label: You keep everything
youKeep.body: After the race, the messages stay. It’s the only memory of your race that has a voice.

Landing.testimonialsTitle: What people tell us at the finish

karim.quote: At km 32 I was about to give up. I heard my daughter’s voice: “come on dad, only ten more”. I finished in tears, but I finished.
karim.author: Karim

lea.quote: I put messages at every pass for my sister without telling her. She called me that night, she hadn’t figured out where the voices came from.
lea.author: Léa
lea.detail: 6 voice notes on a 45 km trail

sophie.quote: The thing is, it comes at the right moment. A cheer at the start is useless. At km 18, it changes everything.
sophie.author: Sophie

Landing.pricingTitle: Free to start. {price} if it overflows.

bibProche.label: Your loved ones
bibProche.note: Always. They never pay a thing.
bibProche.li2: No account, all in the browser

bibCoureur.label: You, the runner
bibCoureur.note: Then {price} to unlock up to {cap}. You pay for everyone.
bibCoureur.li1: GPX, map drawing or timer mode

Landing.finalTitle: Your next race has a date. Give it voices.
Landing.finalBody: GPX, drawn route or a simple timer • create your race and send the link to your loved ones. All that’s left is to run.

Offline.title: No connection
Offline.body: This page needs a network. That said, if you prepared your race ahead of time, the race screen works offline: your voice messages are already on your phone.

LoginPage.metaDescription: Log in to EchoRun to create a race and share your route.
LoginPage.title: Create or find my race
LoginPage.subtitle: No password. We send you a one-time code by email.
LoginPage.terms: By continuing, you accept the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.

LoginForm.tooManyRequests: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a few minutes.
LoginForm.sendFailed: Couldn’t send. Try again in a moment.
LoginForm.codeSentTo: We’ve just sent an 8-digit code to {email}. It’s valid for one hour.
LoginForm.enterSixDigits: Enter the 8 digits received by email.
LoginForm.wrongCode: Wrong or expired code. Check it, or resend a code.

Dashboard.title: My races
Dashboard.emptyBody: Import the GPX file of your next race, then send the link to your loved ones. Three minutes, once.

NewRacePage.title: Import your route
NewRacePage.body: The .gpx file of your race. The organizer almost always provides it; otherwise export it from Strava, Garmin Connect, Komoot or OpenRunner.

RaceDetail.dayBody: Prepare the race the day before, on wifi: the app downloads all the voice messages to your phone so it works without a network.
RaceDetail.sortedBy: Sorted by point on the route
RaceDetail.emptyMessages: No one has left a message yet. Send the share link: that’s the only thing missing.

RaceActions.title: Manage the race
RaceActions.warning: This erases the race and every voice message received. Irreversible.

ShareCard.title: The link to send your loved ones
ShareCard.body: No account, no app. They open it, they speak — 5 messages max per person.
ShareCard.shareTitle: Leave me a voice message for {race}
ShareCard.shareText: I’m running {race}. Drop a voice note on my route, I’ll hear it while running.

UnlockCard.title: Race messages
UnlockCard.countLine: {count} / {cap} messages · your loved ones never pay a thing.
UnlockCard.paymentConfirmed: Payment confirmed! Your race now accepts up to {cap} messages.
UnlockCard.capReachedBody: Your loved ones filled the {freeCap} free messages. Unlock the race to receive up to {cap} in total.
UnlockCard.remainingBody: {remaining, plural, =1 {1 free message left.} other {# free messages left.}} You can unlock now to go up to {cap} in total.
UnlockCard.unlockedBody: Race unlocked: your loved ones can leave up to {cap} messages in total.

FinishPage.summary: {count, plural, =1 {1 of {total} messages played} other {# of {total} messages played}} during {context}.
FinishPage.listBody: They stay playable here. It’s the only memory of your race that has a voice.
FinishPage.nextBody: Import the GPX, resend the link. Your loved ones already know how it works.
